A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SICA and OpenMMSec research. All 22 pages in each version, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-E, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original SICA benchmark results, spectral analyses, cross-domain experiments and ablations in Sections 4-5, with additional evaluations in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results, including OpenMMSec experiments and supplementary ForensicHub, DeepfakeBench and GenImage evaluations.

M1.justification: The frozen CLIP backbone, constrained LoRA adaptation, attention-layer placement and BCE objective remain identical in Sections 4-5 and Appendix E.1.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same four-domain OpenMMSec coverage and retain the same ForensicHub, DeepfakeBench and GenImage evaluations. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within every corresponding comparison in Tables 2 and 6-11. The CLIP-FFT, Effort and other baseline comparisons are unchanged.

E3.justification: The 26 training and 72 testing faking types, sample splits, metrics, training settings and single-domain/leave-one-domain-out protocols are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same supplementary evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Both retain identical spectral analysis, cross-domain reconstruction analysis, rank and backbone ablations, and failure cases (Figures 5 and 7-9; Tables 3-4). No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the absence of reported seed/run counts and uncertainty estimates for benchmark results.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and plotted findings match throughout both PDFs. For example, SICA retains 85.4% overall accuracy in Table 2 and 0.910 average AUC in Table 9; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The feature-space formulation and SVD, projection, outside-energy and cosine-similarity mathematics in Equations 1-8 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, five introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about artifact heterogeneity, semantic structural priors, SICA, OpenMMSec and detection performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning semantic overfitting and near-orthogonal artifact representations remain identical. Section 5.5 retains the same limitations involving complex semantics and inadequate pretraining coverage; Appendix B is unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix E.1 retains the same implementation, hyperparameters, hardware, optimization and preprocessing details. Code/data access statements, construction information and license terms also match.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged in Section 2 and the appendices. Bibliography entries shift between columns and pages without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 adds Mingqi Fang, Zhenming Wang and Jingjing Liu to the author list, adds the University of Science and Technology of China affiliation, and updates dates. Scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block accompanies text and bibliography reflow; the conclusion now ends on page 9 instead of page 8. Figure and table designs remain unchanged, and all appendix pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The revision changes authorship, affiliation and date information and introduces minor repagination. It preserves the scientific arguments, results, limitations and reproducibility information, including identical appendices, leaving no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
